**Finding: deviation (Article X(b), ¶p0125)**

The non-solicit is one-way against us, runs for the Term plus three years, and reaches every employee of Licensor and its Affiliates — two walk-away triggers under NOSOLICIT (>24 months; all Vendor personnel). It does include the general-advertising and unsolicited-inquiry carve-outs and no no-hire, so the redline is minimal: make it mutual, limit it to personnel directly involved in performance, and shorten the tail to 12 months from the end of that involvement (the fallback position), leaving the carve-out sentence intact. Redline validated (ok:true) and finding submitted.
